result.question: What explanation did the old prophet give for the man of God's death?

readings.answer: Because he disobeyed the command of the LORD.
readings.support: disobeyed the command of the LORD

readings.answer: Because the LORD delivered him to the lion, which mauled and killed him.
readings.support: Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him

readings.answer: It happened according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him.
readings.support: according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him

assessments.reason: The prophet explicitly says he “disobeyed the command of the LORD,” which is the stated reason, though it omits the added detail that the LORD then delivered him to the lion.
The prophet says, “Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him,” which explains the death, though it omits the prior cause of disobedience.
He adds it was “according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him,” which is part of the explanation but less complete than the key’s cause-and-means statement.
